info.name: BlurFX
info.comment: Applies a Gaussian blur effect to an input source.

description.p: The BlurFX class performs a Gaussian blur, or approximation thereof, on the input source. The Gaussian blur kernel is an approximation of the normalized convolution G(x,y) = H(x)I(y) where H(x) = exp(-x2/ (2s2)) / sqrt(2* pi*s2) and I(y) = exp(-y2/ (2t2)) / sqrt(2* pi*t2) with 's' being the standard deviation in the x direction and 't' being the standard deviation in the y direction, as specified by SX and SY.
If both SX and SY are zero, the effect copies its input.
The blur is not restricted to whole pixels. It changes continuously with the standard deviation and the display scale, so a blur that covers less than a pixel still softens the input.

field.name: EdgeMode
field.comment: Controls how the blur samples beyond the edges of its input.

description.p: TRANSPARENT (the default) uses transparent black. CLAMP uses the nearest edge sample, REPEAT wraps to the opposite edge and MIRROR reflects alternate copies of the input with the edge sample repeated at each join.

For standard inputs the sampling rectangle is the filter bitmap. For a referenced effect the non-transparent modes use the pixel-aligned bounding rectangle of its transformed primitive subregion, intersected with the filter bitmap. The addressing mode applies along each axis with an active blur.
SVG reads and writes CLAMP as edgeMode="duplicate" and REPEAT as edgeMode="wrap". MIRROR uses the Kōtuku extension kotuku:edgeMode="mirror".

field.name: OutputMode
field.comment: Selects an image or a linear height result.

description.p: In HEIGHT mode, the input can be a native height or a bitmap whose alpha channel supplies the height. Both axes preserve fractional heights. Bind the result to enhanced LightingFX or another height-output blur.

field.name: SX
field.comment: The standard deviation of the blur on the x axis.

description.p: The (SX,SY) field values define the standard deviation of the gaussian blur along each axis.
If either value is 0 or less, the effect is disabled on that axis.

field.name: SY
field.comment: The standard deviation of the blur on the y axis.

description.p: The (SX,SY) field values define the standard deviation of the gaussian blur along each axis.
If either value is 0 or less, the effect is disabled on that axis.

field.name: XMLDef
field.comment: Returns an SVG compliant XML string that describes the effect.
